fallbacks.no_candidate_point: copy arc from nearest-in-time decoded point; if none, globally nearest arc
fallbacks.no_connector_between_route_arcs: route continues without connector; counted as a disconnection

notes: B's LightGBM classifier (features.build_features + models.zoo) is now plugged in via pathsnap/predict.py:_classifier_probs. Tuned with Optuna TPE over features.build_features/models.zoo's own CV rows (train partition, step=3, usable_only=True, GroupKFold by trip) -- time-boxed to 20 completed trials (not the originally planned 40) because of a hard ~30-minute wall-clock budget; best trial cv_macro_f1=0.9274 vs B's untuned 0.9273 (essentially tied), but test_top1 0.8718 vs B's 0.8818 (untuned is slightly better on student_test) at ~18x faster inference (1.1 vs 20.7 ms/1k rows) -- see results/optuna_classifier.db, results/optuna_classifier_trials.csv, results/classifier_tuned_vs_untuned.csv. lgbm_tuned.joblib (refit on all 80 training trips) is used anyway per the task spec; artifacts/models/lgbm.joblib (B's untuned fit) is untouched. alpha was NOT retuned jointly with sigma/beta/uturn_penalty (no new decoder Optuna study, time-boxed) -- those three stay at the v1_1-aligned-tuned-distance-only values. alpha was chosen from a 5-point grid {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0} using 2-fold out-of-fold classifier probabilities on all 80 training trips (fit on one half, score the other, and vice versa, covering every point not just B's 1-in-3 CV sample) against the existing decoder cache: objective = mean Top-1 - 0.002 x mean disconnections per trip. alpha=0.5 won (objective 0.8386 vs 0.8237 at alpha=0); disconnections fell monotonically with alpha (7.09 at 0 down to 2.19 at 1.0) but Top-1 peaked at 0.5 and dropped at alpha=1.0 (pure classifier, no distance term) -- see results/alpha_grid.csv. Final student_test comparison (nearest / classifier-only / distance-only HMM / classifier+HMM): results/final_comparison.csv, results/figures/final_comparison.png.
